scenes.summary: Leon, a UWST patrol crew mate, needs your help to repair a platform lift. The man claims that the broken lift is affecting both his work and his health.

lines.text: Greetings. Are you from the repair crew?
Endfielders? Wait. That means you're the Endmin, right?! Awesome. This platform lift might just very well...
Ah, sorry for skipping the intro. The name's Leon. I'm a UWST patroler. The Ankhorfall busted the control system of this machine and we couldn't get it to start.
I called the repair crew a couple times. They kept telling me they're too busy and my issue doesn't qualify for a top priority ticket.
But my bloody platform lift is the key logistics link between 2 friggin' regions! We gotta get the thing fixed or nothing will ever get done at this place!
And ... phooo ... this problem is affecting my health!

Yes indeed. I take the platform lift to the roof precisely at noon and have my lunch at the place with the best view. I spent years in this career without skipping my rooftop lunch. Even got my bloody schedule down to the minute.

Now, the elevator is broken and I gotta take the long detour to reach the top floor. It messed up my schedule, my appetite, and my life. I'm getting gastric problems because I can't get my bloody lunch on time!
I thought I could use my drone to help my work, but Rorke borrowed it in the morning and didn't even bother returning it. Bloody greenhorn messed up my schedule for the day...
You will? Nice. The control panel is atop that building. It's just that ... the gate is broken. I can't figure out how to get up there.
Oh, thank you! Fixing that thing will really save my life!

options: No worries. You can count on me.

lines.text: The platform lift is now working according to schedule. I'm feeling much better already!
Finally... The platform lift is working again. Wonderful.
Of course it does! Here. Token of my gratitude. Please take it.
Before I forget, you can look around the place up there. Perhaps you might find something you could use.
The elevator for reaching that place is also linked to the platform lift control system. You can use the elevator now.
